overview.title: Overview
overview.text1: Beijing Academy was established in September 2013. We are a 12-year public school approved by the Beijing Municipal Government and funded by the Chaoyang District Government. Our school is built to become a modern community with a unique Beijing style, a distinctive Chinese character and a global perspective.
overview.text2: In 2020, our international department was approved by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission as a sino-foreign cooperative high school education program. We are an authorized AP school, a CIS member school, an ACT testing center, and a Cambridge International Curriculum school.
overview.text3: Beijing Academy promotes students' comprehensive personal growth. We believe that through the efforts of both our students and teachers, we can realize our motto: "Better me, better world," wand that all of us will make the world a better place.

about.accreditationText: BAID is authorized as an AP curriculum school by the College Board. We are the first public high school in China to receive CIS accreditation, and an authorized global ACT-GAC official teaching and testing center. We are authorized with the Cambridge international curriculum, and has been designated as an "Apple Distinguished School."
